caption: The drawing depicts a scene featuring three main objects: a human figure, a castle tower, and a human figure attached to the tower. On the left side, there is a standing male figure dressed in Renaissance-style clothing, consisting of a red hat, green doublet, beige puffed shorts, cream tights, and red boots. He has a mustache and beard, and he is aiming a large, old-fashioned musket or blunderbuss toward the right. His attire is detailed in shades of green, red, cream, and brown. To the right, there is a light brown castle tower with visible brick patterns, small windows, and a green base. Directly in front of the tower, partially obscured by it, stands a smaller human figure. This figure has short black hair with a yellow ornament on top, is dressed in a red shirt, tan shorts, and red shoes, and is positioned facing sideways, looking toward the left. The figures and tower are all positioned on an elongated green base. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Toy Bank
